name: @kitora/i18n
description: Kitora's shared message catalog: typed per-kit namespaces with English defaults, locale bundles with fallback (de-AT → de → en), single-key overrides, {name} interpolation and Intl.PluralRules plurals, a nesting I18nProvider with no global state, and a locale-to-direction bridge to the theme kit.

exports.name: isPluralForms
exports.description: Whether `value` is valid plural forms: an object with a string `other` and only CLDR category keys with string values.

exports.name: isMessageTemplate
exports.description: Whether `value` is a catalog entry: a plain string or valid plural forms.

exports.name: interpolate
exports.description: Fill `{name}` placeholders. Unknown names stay as written, so a typo is visible instead of silently blank.

exports.name: pluralSelector
exports.description:
The plural selector for a locale. An unknown or malformed locale tag falls back to a selector
that always answers `other`, so a bad tag degrades to the `other` form instead of throwing.

exports.name: renderTemplate
exports.description: Render one template: pick the plural form by `params.n` (via `select`), then fill the placeholders.
exports.signature: (template: MessageTemplate, params?: MessageParams, select?: PluralSelector) => string

exports.name: formatMessage
exports.description: One-off rendering in a locale (builds plural rules each call; a translator caches them).
exports.signature: (template: MessageTemplate, params?: MessageParams, locale?: string) => string

exports.name: PLURAL_CATEGORIES
exports.description: CLDR plural categories (`Intl.PluralRules#select` results).

exports.name: PluralCategory
exports.description: One CLDR plural category: `zero`, `one`, `two`, `few`, `many` or `other`.

exports.name: PluralForms
exports.description: A plural message: one template per category the locale uses; `other` is required, it is the fallback.

exports.name: MessageTemplate
exports.description: One catalog entry: a plain template or plural forms. `{name}` is replaced by the `name` param.

exports.name: MessageParams
exports.description: Values substituted into `{name}` placeholders. `n` also selects the plural form.

exports.name: PLURAL_PARAM
exports.description: The param that selects a plural form.

exports.name: PluralSelector
exports.description: Picks a plural category for a number; `Intl.PluralRules` in practice, swappable in tests.

exports.name: defineMessages
exports.description:
Declare a kit's namespace. The defaults' shape is the namespace's type: every key a component
may ask for, and whether it is a plain string or plural forms.
exports.signature: <C extends Catalog>(id: string, defaults: C & CatalogShape<C>, options?: DefineMessagesOptions<NoInfer<CatalogShape<C>>>) => MessageNamespace<CatalogShape<C>>

exports.name: messagesFor
exports.description: Type-checked translations for one namespace, ready to merge into a bundle or an override layer.
exports.signature: <C extends Catalog>(namespace: MessageNamespace<C>, messages: NoInfer<Partial<C>>) => MessageOverrides

exports.name: createBundle
exports.description: One locale's bundle from any number of `messagesFor` results (later namespaces' keys win).

exports.name: mergeOverrides
exports.description: Merge override layers key by key, later wins; an explicit `undefined` keeps the earlier value.

exports.name: localeChain
exports.description:
A locale tag and its less specific parents, most specific first: `de-AT` → `de-AT`, `de`;
`zh-Hant-TW` → `zh-Hant-TW`, `zh-Hant`, `zh`. Underscores are read as hyphens. Empty gives none.

exports.name: bundlesFor
exports.description: The bundles that apply to `locale`, least specific first, so a more specific bundle wins when merged.
exports.signature: (locale: string, bundles: readonly MessageBundle[]) => readonly MessageBundle[]

exports.name: negotiateLocale
exports.description:
The first available locale that matches a requested one (exact tag, then a parent of it, then a
child sharing its language), trying requests in order; `fallback` when none matches. For picking
a locale from `navigator.languages` or an `Accept-Language` list.
exports.signature: (requested: readonly string[], available: readonly string[], fallback?: string) => string

exports.name: resolveCatalog
exports.description: The namespace's catalog for a locale: defaults, then the kit's own translations and the host's bundles for that locale (host wins), then overrides.
exports.signature: <C extends Catalog>(namespace: MessageNamespace<C>, { locale, bundles, overrides }?: ResolveOptions) => C

exports.name: Catalog
exports.description: A full catalog: every key with its template.

exports.name: TEMPLATE_KINDS
exports.description:
Whether a translation must keep each default's kind. `strict` (the default): a plain string
replaces a plain string, plural forms replace plural forms, so a component may read a plain key
straight off the catalog. `any`: either kind replaces either, for a namespace read only through a
translator's `t` (which renders both).

exports.name: TemplateKinds
exports.description: One of {@link TEMPLATE_KINDS}: `strict` keeps each default's kind, `any` lets either kind replace either.

exports.name: MessageNamespace
exports.description: A kit's message namespace: its id (the key hosts translate it under) and its English defaults.

exports.name: DefineMessagesOptions
exports.description: Options for `defineMessages`: the namespace's template-kind rule and the translations the kit ships.

exports.name: CatalogOf
exports.description: The catalog type of a namespace value: `Partial<CatalogOf<typeof NS>>` is a translation of it.

exports.name: MessageKey
exports.description: The keys of a namespace's catalog.

exports.name: MessageOverrides
exports.description: Translations for any number of namespaces, keyed by namespace id; each a partial catalog.

exports.name: MessageBundle
exports.description: One locale's translations. `locale` is a BCP 47 tag (`de`, `de-AT`, `pt-BR`).

exports.name: DEFAULT_LOCALE
exports.description: The locale used when nothing names one; the defaults are written in it.

exports.name: CatalogShape
exports.description:
A catalog's declared shape with its literal types widened: a plain key takes any string, a plural
key any plural forms (English writes `one`/`other`; Polish adds `few` and `many`).

exports.name: ResolveOptions
exports.description: What `resolveCatalog` and `createTranslator` apply on top of a namespace's defaults.

exports.name: translatorFor
exports.description: Build a translator from an already resolved catalog. Plural rules are built once, on first use.
exports.signature: <C extends Catalog>(catalog: C, locale?: string) => Translator<C>

exports.name: createTranslator
exports.description: Resolve a namespace for a locale (bundles, overrides) and wrap it in a translator.
exports.signature: <C extends Catalog>(namespace: MessageNamespace<C>, options?: ResolveOptions) => Translator<C>

exports.name: Translator
exports.description: One namespace's resolved catalog in one locale, with `t` to turn a key into text.

exports.name: readDocumentLocale
exports.description: The `lang` of an element, or of `<html>` by default; null when unset or with no document.

exports.name: applyDocumentLocale
exports.description:
Set `lang` on an element (`<html>` by default) and return a function that restores the previous
value, for a provider that owns the page's language for its lifetime. A no-op with no document.

exports.name: browserLocales
exports.description: The browser's preferred locales, most preferred first (`navigator.languages`); empty on a server.

exports.name: I18nProvider
exports.description: Set the locale and add translations or overrides for every kit below.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for everything below (`de`, `ar-EG`); inherits the parent's, then `en`.

props.name: bundles
props.description: Translations, any locales; only those on the locale's fallback chain apply.

props.name: messages
props.description: Single keys replaced whatever the locale (a product's wording), as `{ namespace: { key: text } }`.

props.name: documentLang
props.description: Whether to also write `lang` on `<html>` while mounted, and restore it after.

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree that reads this locale, bundles and overrides.

exports.name: useI18nFrame
exports.description: The providers' accumulated frame, for a host bridging it into another system.

exports.name: useHasI18nProvider
exports.description: True when some `I18nProvider` is above; a kit with its own legacy catalog can then defer to it.

exports.name: useLocale
exports.description: The locale in effect (the nearest provider's, else `en`).

exports.name: useMessages
exports.description:
A namespace's catalog here: defaults, the locale's bundles, the providers' overrides, then
`local` (a component's own props) on top. Stable while its inputs are, so it is safe in deps.
exports.signature: <C extends Catalog>(namespace: MessageNamespace<C>, local?: NoInfer<Partial<C>>) => C

exports.name: useTranslator
exports.description: A translator for a namespace here (see {@link useMessages}): `t(key, params)` with plurals in the current locale.
exports.signature: <C extends Catalog>(namespace: MessageNamespace<C>, local?: NoInfer<Partial<C>>) => Translator<C>

exports.name: I18nFrame
exports.description: What every provider adds to the one above.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for everything below (`de`, `ar-EG`); inherits the parent's, then `en`.

props.name: bundles
props.description: Translations, any locales; only those on the locale's fallback chain apply.

props.name: messages
props.description: Single keys replaced whatever the locale (a product's wording), as `{ namespace: { key: text } }`.

props.name: documentLang
props.description: Whether to also write `lang` on `<html>` while mounted, and restore it after.

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree that reads this locale, bundles and overrides.

exports.name: LocaleDirection
exports.description: Reading direction from the current locale: `ar`, `he`, `fa`, `ur` … flip to rtl, everything else is ltr.

props.name: target
props.description: Where `dir` lands, as on the theme kit's DirectionProvider (default `wrapper`).

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the wrapper element (when `target` draws one).

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style on the wrapper element (when `target` draws one).

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree whose reading direction follows the locale.

exports.name: localeName
exports.description:
A language's name: in `displayLocale` (default: the language itself, the way a picker should show
it), from `Intl.DisplayNames`; the tag itself when the platform has no name for it.

exports.name: localeSelectOptions
exports.description: Builds the labelled list a `LocaleSelect` draws: plain tags are named in their own language.

exports.name: LocaleSelect
exports.description: A compact language picker (`h-7`), searchable past {@link LOCALE_SELECT_SEARCH_FROM} languages. Controlled: put its value on an `I18nProvider`'s `locale`.

props.name: options
props.description: The languages to offer, in display order: plain tags (named in their own language) or {@link LocaleOption}s.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen locale tag.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user picks a language, with its locale tag.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name (default the catalog's `language`).

props.name: id
props.description: The control's id (default a generated one).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the picker is disabled.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the control, merged with the compact defaults.

props.name: classNames
props.type: { readonly trigger?: string; readonly item?: string }
props.description: `trigger` styles the control; `item` styles each built-in option (a custom `renderSelect` gets `trigger` merged into `className`).

props.name: renderSelect
props.description: Draws the control instead of the built-in select.

exports.name: I18N_MESSAGES
exports.description: The i18n kit's own strings.

props.name: target
props.description: Where `dir` lands, as on the theme kit's DirectionProvider (default `wrapper`).

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the wrapper element (when `target` draws one).

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style on the wrapper element (when `target` draws one).

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree whose reading direction follows the locale.

exports.name: LocaleOption
exports.description: One language a `LocaleSelect` offers, with an optional label of your own.

exports.name: LocaleSelectOption
exports.description: One language in the list a `LocaleSelect` draws, already labelled.

exports.name: LocaleSelectRenderProps
exports.description:
What a custom locale control receives (see `LocaleSelectProps.renderSelect`). Shaped like
pickers' `RecurrenceFrequencySelectProps`, so one host adapter (e.g. on the collections
`Select`) can fill both slots.

props.name: id
props.description: Put it on the control, so a host `<label htmlFor>` can name it.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen locale tag.

props.name: options
props.description: Every language in display order, already labelled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the user picks a language, with its locale tag.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name: the caller's `label`, else the catalog's `language`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the control is disabled.

props.name: className
props.description: The caller's `className` merged with `classNames.trigger` and the compact defaults.

props.name: options
props.description: The languages to offer, in display order: plain tags (named in their own language) or {@link LocaleOption}s.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen locale tag.

props.description: Called when the user picks a language, with its locale tag.

props.name: disabled

props.name: className

exports.name: LOCALE_SELECT_SEARCH_FROM
exports.description: A list longer than this gets a search box in its popup.
